status: drafted by the authors; every judgement listed (J01 to J17) for independent review

operations.feature: Drive-end (DE) face, z = 168.5
operations.tool: CNMG 120408 rough + CNMG 120404 finish pass (TurningInsertRough / TurningInsertFinish)
operations.note: Datum face for E = 50; constant surface speed.

operations.feature: Spot/centre on axis before tap drill
operations.tool: Spot drill 90 deg or DIN 332-2 form-DS stepped centre drill
operations.note: Not needed if 10.03-10.05 use one DIN 332-2 stepped centre drill.

operations.feature: Tap-drill hole d 6.8, full-diameter depth 25.0 from DE face (R07)
operations.tool: HSS twist drill 6.8, 118 deg (DrillBit); axial peck cycle at X0

operations.feature: Counterbore d 8.4, flat floor at z = 162.5 (R08)
operations.tool: Flat-bottom counterbore (CounterboreCutter) or step of DIN 332-2 drill
operations.note: Floor is planar in the B-Rep (PLANE at z = 162.5).

operations.feature: 60 deg countersink to d 12.2 (R09), DIN 332-2 centre seat
operations.tool: 60 deg countersink / DIN 332-2 stepped drill; NOT in tools.owl (only 90 deg chamfer tools)
operations.note: Bearing surface for tailstock live centre.

operations.feature: Engage tailstock live 60 deg centre in R09
operations.tool: Live centre; tailstock not modelled in machines.owl

operations.feature: Rough turn d 24.0 seat (R05), leave 0.2-0.3 on diameter
operations.tool: CNMG 120408 (TurningInsertRough)

operations.feature: Rough turn d 24.95 body (R01) back past NDE face + parting width
operations.tool: CNMG 120408 (TurningInsertRough)

operations.feature: Undercut d 23.6 x 1.754 at shaft-end root (R03)
operations.tool: Grooving/profiling insert of width <= 1.5 mm with corner radius, or undercut form insert; tools.owl GroovingTool is 2 mm wide
operations.note: Recess below both neighbours; 15 deg run-out resembles a DIN 509 grinding relief.

operations.feature: 15 deg run-out cone d 23.6 -> 24.0 (R04)
operations.tool: Profiled with the undercut tool or in the finishing contour
operations.note: Any of the three families accepted.

operations.feature: Finish turn d 24 j6 seat (R05): +0.009/-0.004
operations.tool: CNMG 120404 (TurningInsertFinish) or 35 deg profiling insert; G42 nose-radius compensation, in-process gauging

operations.feature: Finish turn d 24.95 body (R01)
operations.tool: CNMG 120404 (TurningInsertFinish)

operations.feature: 1 x 45 deg end chamfer d 24 -> 22 (R10), turned in contour
operations.tool: Turning insert (contour); not a chamfer mill

operations.feature: 0.5 x 45 deg chamfer d 24.95 -> 23.95 (R02), turned in contour
operations.tool: Turning insert (contour); not a chamfer mill

operations.feature: Tap M8 x 1.25-6H in R07 (thread depth per DIN 332-2)
operations.tool: HSS-E spiral-flute machine tap, rigid tapping (G84, stationary tap on centreline) or floating holder; NOT in ontology

operations.feature: Part off at z ~ 80.0 (0.5 mm facing allowance)
operations.tool: Parting blade/insert; NOT in ontology
operations.note: Not needed if sawn blanks are used (J14).

operations.machine: CNC lathe (reversed, soft jaws on d 24.95, stop on R02 shoulder)
operations.feature: Non-drive-end (NDE) face to overall length 88.0, z = 80.5
operations.tool: CNMG 120404 (TurningInsertFinish)
operations.note: Never clamp on the j6 seat.

operations.feature: Edge break NDE outer edge (not modelled in CAD)
operations.tool: Turning insert

operations.machine: Vertical milling machine / VMC (NOT in machines.owl)
operations.feature: Keyway 8 N9 (7.964-8.000) x t1 4.0 +0.2 x 40, form A (R4 ends), z 123.5-163.5, symmetric to axis
operations.tool: 2-flute carbide keyway end mill d 8 (keyway tolerance) or undersize rough + side finish; tools.owl EndMill is a generic 4-flute
operations.note: Replaces the catalogue CAD's fitted key (R06).

operations.feature: Deburr keyway edges
operations.tool: Hand/brush

operations.feature: Grind d 24 j6 seat (R05) if turning cannot hold IT6
operations.tool: Plain wheel; undercut R03/R04 gives run-out

operations.feature: j6 seat, run-out (IEC 60072-1 class), keyway width/depth (G = 20.0)/symmetry, M8-6H plug gauge, E = 50, GA = 27 after key fitted
operations.tool: Air gauge/micrometer, slot gauge, thread plug gauge
